fine.note: No delay penalties or liquidated damages specified in the contract.
Payment terms of 30 days with no set-off rights match AtliQ standard.
Liability cap is mutual and capped at 12 months of fees paid.
Indemnification is limited to IP infringement for AtliQ and customer data for TravelHub.
IP transfers upon full payment, and AtliQ retains background technology.
Termination for convenience provides payment for all work performed up to termination.
Confidentiality obligations are mutual with standard exceptions and a 3-year duration.
Non-solicitation clause is mutual and limited to 12 months.
Data protection terms align with applicable UAE and Saudi data protection legislation.
No burdensome insurance requirements or unheld coverage limits are imposed.
Acceptance mechanism includes a 10-business-day review period with deemed acceptance.
60-day warranty post-acceptance with standard disclaimer matches expectations.
